content.text:
**PASS 1 FOUND 1 FINDING.**

- **[P2] ENP-FND-050: expired or duplicate stream subscriptions can still consume the response body.**  
  [http-client.ts:380](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/http-client.ts:380) calls `Deferred.succeed`, but `Effect.as` discards its boolean result. In pinned Effect v4, that result indicates whether this subscriber actually completed the `Deferred`. After watchdog expiry, scope closure has already completed it, yet a late subscriber still proceeds to `response.stream`. A second subscriber behaves similarly. Buffered responses may therefore remain consumable after ownership expiry, while concurrent subscribers can contend for the same one-shot body.

  **Proof gap:** [codex-responses-proof.test.ts:539](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/test/codex-responses-proof.test.ts:539) proves abort and unread bytes at expiry but never attempts a late subscription. No test proves duplicate subscription rejection.

  **Required correction:** branch on the `Deferred.succeed` result and return a fixed `CodexResponsesStreamError` when ownership was already claimed or expired. Add deterministic late-subscription and duplicate-subscription tests.

  **Requirements:** `ENP-REQ-001`, `ENP-REQ-005`, `ENP-REQ-007`, `ENP-REQ-011`.

ENP-FND-044 through ENP-FND-049 are otherwise implemented consistently with their recorded decisions. Provider/hosted behaviour remains unproved, as expected.

No files were changed and no test suite was rerun.
